Weekly Races (Solo)

UTC Days & Times: Tue Wed Thu Mon, starts every 2hrs from midnight
Special Events (Team)
8 Hours of Daytona [SR B2, No :RookieDriver: or :DangerousDriver: badges permitted]: Daytona (RC), Hypercar LMP2 (WEC) & LMGT3 classes, 44 car splits, 480m races, open setup, tyre warmers disabled, fair share applies, 3x time scale (24h in 8h), tyres: 30
Race start: 1:00pm in-game time
UTC Days & Times: Fri Sat Sun @ 0300 0800 1300 2000
IMPORTANT: If you are running on a low/mid spec system, ensure you check you can run the larger grids smoothly (62 cars, the day to night to day transition, rain/wet track) in single player before registering to a race. You may need to significantly reduce your graphics settings (lowest), set FSR to ultra performance, increase your pagefile size in Windows to over 32GB. If you cannot run this event smoothly, do not register for it.
👀 Schedule testing continues! Expect some different events for the foreseeable while we try new things out in daily/weekly 😄🔧
